frontmatter.name: handoff-resumer
frontmatter.description: Use this agent when the user asks to "implement the handoff", "continue the handoff", "resume where we left off", or "pick up the previous session" for this repository — regardless of which AI runtime wrote the original handoff. Finds the latest handoff file across all runtimes, verifies the tree matches what it claims, and resumes from its exact recorded next action.
frontmatter.Context: A user returns to the same Claude Code project days later.
frontmatter.assistant: Checking docs/ai/handoff/ for the most recent handoff file before doing anything else.
